item.title: Patch now: IBM Aspera Faspex: Incorrect Authorization
item.description:
IBM Aspera Faspex: Broken access control · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 5.0.19.1

First step: Update IBM Aspera Faspex to 5.0.19.1 or later.

IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-123218
